property.name: defaultReportId
property.label: Default Custom Report Id
property.description: Optional Report_Definition__c record Id to select when the component loads.

property.name: defaultReportName
property.label: Default Custom Report Name
property.description: Optional saved custom report name to select when no Id is provided.

property.name: autoRunOnLoad
property.label: Run Automatically
property.description: Run the configured custom report as soon as the Home Page loads.

property.name: hideReportSelector
property.label: Hide Report Selector
property.description: Hide the report picker when this component is configured for one report.

property.name: hideExportButton
property.label: Hide Export Button
property.description: Hide export actions from the Home Page component.

property.name: reportPageSize
property.label: Preview Row Limit
property.description: Rows fetched for the Home Page preview. Values are capped at 500.
